description: This file defines an interface for building responses and events related to 'ModifyFeatures' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, including factories for responses and events, and methods for creating specific response types and events.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for ModifyFeatures commands.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects related to ModifyFeatures.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by ModifyFeatures commands.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesCreated event based on the command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesModified event based on the command.

methods.name: featuresNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating features are not accessible.

methods.name: featuresNotModifiableError
methods.description: Builds an error response indicating features are not modifiable.
